label: FP
reason: Alert 1 (xss) alert-FP: User-controlled 'state' parameter is used ONLY as a session attribute key ('oauth_state_' + state), not as part of the redirect URL. The resolved sink value at response.sendRedirect(redirect) comes from request.getSession().getAttribute(...) which retrieves a pre-stored value—not attacker-controlled input. The state parameter never flows into the redirect URL expression itself.

evidence.note: state param used as session key, redirect retrieved from session, no user input reaches sendRedirect()
